html:
The Yanga were an Aboriginal Australian people of inland north Queensland, on the map in the upper Gilbert and Einasleigh river country.

Almost nothing is recorded about them. Their neighbours on the map are the Mbara, Takalak, Agwarmin and Mayi-Kulan. The Etheridge goldfield, opened around 1870 near today's Georgetown, and the cattle runs that followed brought settlers into this country.
sum: The Yanga were an Aboriginal Australian people of inland north Queensland, on the map in the upper Gilbert and Einasleigh river country.
